about: World 9, Puzzle Pier: match-the-edges jigsaws (Tarsia puzzles), one for each ChemQuest topic. Each puzzle has 6 square pieces on a 3 × 2 board. The 7 pairs go on the edges where two pieces meet: one half of the pair on each side, so pieces only fit when the edges match. Decoys go on the outside edges, which touch nothing. Keep every text short (26 characters at most) and make sure no text could sensibly match two others. picture = the world whose scene appears when the puzzle is finished.

levels.title: Ions and names
levels.subtitle: Lab Meadow · names and formulae

levels.title: Electron addresses
levels.subtitle: Orbital Ruins · electron configuration
levels.tip: Match each element to its ground-state electron configuration. Count the electrons: they add up to the atomic number.

levels.title: Which way?
levels.subtitle: Trend Peaks · periodic trends
levels.tip: Match each trend question to its answer. Remember: atoms get bigger down a group and smaller across a period.
